class.name: CgamePartyMigration
class.brief_description: Cross-server party directory whose authority follows the party leader.
class.description: [CgamePartyMigration] keeps the parties known to one server. A party document is [code]{id, leader, home, epoch, version, members}[/code], where [code]members[/code] maps each player to the server that hosts them. Only the home server (the leader's server) may change a party. [method leader_handoff] moves the home and increases the epoch, so a stale former home cannot overwrite newer state. Other servers install snapshots with [method apply_replica]: a higher (epoch, version) wins and replays are no-ops.

method.name: has_party
method.description: Returns whether the directory knows the party.

method.name: get_doc
method.description: Returns the live party document (not a copy), or an empty dictionary.

method.name: snapshot
method.description: Returns a deep copy of the party document for replication.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a party led by [param leader], hosted on this server, which becomes the home. Returns [code]false[/code] if the id exists.

method.name: add_member
method.description: Adds a member hosted on [param server]. Refused unless this server is the home.

method.name: remove_member
method.description: Removes a member. Removing the leader promotes the lowest-sorted remaining member and bumps the epoch; an empty party disbands. Refused unless this server is the home.

method.name: set_member_server
method.description: Updates the server hosting a member. Returns [code]false[/code] if nothing changed or this server is not the home.

method.name: leader_handoff
method.description: Moves the home to [param dest] after the leader moved there and bumps the epoch. Returns the snapshot to replicate, or an empty dictionary if refused.

method.name: follow_plan
method.description: Returns [code]{player, from, to}[/code] steps for the members that should follow the leader to [param dest]. A non-empty [param nearby] restricts the plan to those players.

method.name: apply_replica
method.description: Installs a snapshot if it is newer by (epoch, version). Returns [code]true[/code] if anything changed.

method.name: servers_of
method.description: Returns the sorted servers that host a member, plus the home.

method.name: same_as
method.description: Returns whether another directory (any object with [code]get_doc()[/code]) holds an identical document for [param id].

members.member: Id of the server that owns this directory.
Party documents keyed by party id.
